scope: Batch characterization of the 5 userdata metatables in the d2fXXX cluster (BCS-Y-0500). Decompiled all template constructors + 16 readable metamethod impls + at least one owning caller per template + the FUN_00d1ce10 'BaseClass' registration site. String-ref scan over the four dispatcher helpers recovered the full field-name vocabulary.
outcome: All 5 metatables wrap pieces of the FFXIV 1.x Lua Game Engine (LGE) class system. The 'BaseClass' caller FUN_00d1ce10 (reached from _onLoop.__index = FUN_00d085b0, lge_bootstrap_attribution.json) is the class-registration entry point; it installs FUN_00D20B00 as the metatable for instances. Class instances expose 6 special fields (_save, _temp, _sync, _tag, _bind, _debug); the three pool fields read userdata of FUN_00D208A0 (memory-pool wrapper) which itself exposes 15 size-bookkeeping fields. FUN_00D207A0 wraps the member-descriptor records allocated when scripts assign a value to a class-instance field (the 0x54-byte block FUN_00d175b0 allocates). FUN_00D20540 is an indexed container (length at +0x58, vtable at +0x54) holding member records. FUN_00D20670 is a smaller 2-slot dispatcher (vtable+4/+8 tail-calls) that likely represents a cursor/pair entry within the container. The whole cluster forms one cohesive subsystem rather than five unrelated wrappers.
subsystem: FFXIV 1.x LGE class system (Lua Game Engine) - instance, member descriptor, container, cursor, and per-instance memory pools
wrappedTypeFamily: FFXIV.Client.LGE class infrastructure (C++ types unnamed in PDB; RTTI absent for this cluster)

templates.name: LGE BaseClass instance metatable
templates.innerSize_bytes: varies (instance struct allocated by caller, with +0x60/+0x64/+0x68 = save/temp/sync pool*; +0x30 = name; +0x34 = state; vtable at *param_1)
templates.constructor: FUN_00d1ce10 (1943 bytes, __thiscall, the 'BaseClass' class registration entry; pushes 'BaseClass' literal twice; iterates class table at param_1[1]+0xc; for each field declares it; finally calls FUN_00D20B00 to install the metatable)

indexHelper.behavior: Generic member-name dispatcher via FUN_00d16cd0 lookup. If found, copies the member name into param_1+0x30 (active-dispatch slot) and calls vtable +0x1c on the member-descriptor. Falls through to _save/_temp/_sync local readers if not found (returning a pool userdata or 1 if pool is non-null).

newindexHelper.behavior: Same lookup pattern, but on miss compares against _save/_temp/_sync/_tag/_bind/_debug. The _tag branch allocates a 0x54-byte block via FUN_009d1b35(0x54) and routes through FUN_00d26b10/26ea0/_etc (the 0x54 block IS the inner struct of a D207A0 userdata - mutating _tag dynamically attaches a member descriptor).

templates.interpretation: Each LGE class instance owns 3 memory pools (save = persistent state, temp = transient/per-frame, sync = network-replicated), plus _tag (instance type marker), _bind (network-binding hook), _debug (instrumentation). Members are looked up through the parent class's member table; reads/writes dispatch through per-member vtables.

templates.name: LGE memory pool wrapper
templates.constructor: FUN_00d21090 (own) - allocates 0x28 via FUN_009d1b35 + inits via FUN_00d2efb0; FUN_00d20aa0 (borrow) - wraps existing pointer

indexHelper.behavior: Long if/else cascade over 15 field names. Pool fields (_save/_temp/_sync) push a Lua truthy via FUN_00d1da80 routing. Size queries delegate to FUN_00d1dca0 (allocated), FUN_00d1ddc0 (assigned), FUN_00d1dee0 (available) or the inline (>>3) bit-count calc.

newindexHelper.behavior: Empty `return;` stub (3 bytes). Pools are read-only from Lua - assignment is silently no-op. Distinct from the FUN_00ab7340 `return 0;` 3-byte stub used by other read-only metatables.

templates.interpretation: Lua-side view of the engine's three-scope memory allocator (save = persistent, temp = transient, sync = replicated). Exposes bookkeeping for scripts to introspect memory pressure (allocated vs assigned vs available) per scope without granting mutation.

templates.name: LGE member descriptor wrapper
templates.constructor: FUN_00d20fd0 (own, 5th arg=1) - alloc 0x54 + init via FUN_00d1c100; FUN_00d20f10 (own, 5th arg=0); FUN_00d20a40 (borrow)

indexHelper.behavior: Looks up Lua arg-2 as field name via FUN_00d1df90 against the lookup table at +0x48. If found, vtable-call +0x1c (member getter). Falls through to FUN_00cf3320(1) on the +0x4e read-only flag if name matches DAT_013780a8/01378050. Returns nil otherwise.

newindexHelper.behavior: Largest helper in the cluster (940 bytes). Looks up the field, then if mutation is permitted (+0x4e flag + +0x48 non-null) calls a 7-arg setter via FUN_00d272d0 (the shared member-write helper used by D20540's __newindex too). Has special-case branches for +0xb byte tags DAT_0130d422/0130d423 (likely 'method-call' vs 'value-set' member kinds).

templates.interpretation: Wraps a single member descriptor of an LGE class - the record that defines how reads/writes to one named field of an instance are dispatched (which getter, which setter, what type, mutable or not). Allocated dynamically when D20B00's __newindex declares a new member (the 0x54 block FUN_00d175b0 allocates).

templates.name: LGE indexed container
templates.constructor: FUN_00d20cb0 (own) - alloc 0x5c via FUN_009d1b35 + init via FUN_00d2e230; FUN_00d20980 (borrow)

indexHelper.behavior: Reads integer Lua arg-2 (FUN_009d6600 = lua_tonumber-or-int). Bounds-check against [1, +0x58]. On in-range: vtable-call +0x1c with (param_1+4, getter_state, arg2, integer_key, tag_a, tag_b). On out-of-range: error via FUN_00cf33a0.

newindexHelper.behavior: Same bounds check, then FUN_00d272d0 write at (param_1+4, getter_state, param_1+0x34, param_1+0x44, arg2, integer_key, tag_a, tag_b). Same write path used by D207A0 - the container shares the engine's generic member-write machinery.

lenImpl.behavior: Reads (int)*(piVar2+0x58) and pushes as double - virtual length field at struct +0x58.

powImpl.behavior: Calls FUN_00d2e170 which probably implements a container operation (set inclusion / exponentiation overload). Common across the cluster - 4 of 5 templates expose __pow.

templates.interpretation: Fixed-length array/container of typed entries (probably member descriptors or named slots). The vtable at +0x54 abstracts the element type, so this template serves multiple element types via different ctors (D20cb0 vs D20980). __pow makes the type subscriptable with arithmetic-like syntax - probably class introspection (`Class ^ 'fieldName'` returns the field descriptor or similar Lua idiom).

templates.name: LGE cursor/pair entry
templates.constructor: FUN_00d20d70 (own, 9 params, init FUN_00d2e360); FUN_00d20e40 (own, 8 params, init FUN_00d2e2d0); FUN_00d209e0 (borrow)

structLayout.+0x04: vtable*_or_target_ptr (dereferenced through *(piVar+4) then vtable + offset for __index/__newindex)

indexHelper.behavior: 10-byte tail-call: `(**(code **)(**(int **)(param_1 + 4) + 8))();` - vtable slot +8 of the wrapped object at +4.

newindexHelper.behavior: 10-byte tail-call: `(**(code **)(**(int **)(param_1 + 4) + 4))();` - vtable slot +4 of the wrapped object at +4.

lenImpl.behavior: Calls FUN_00d2e420 (no-arg) then pushes return as double - virtual length probably equivalent.

powImpl.behavior: Boolean return via FUN_00d2e430 (with stack-buffer arg) - probably membership / equality test.

templates.interpretation: Tiny 8-byte wrapper that delegates EVERY operation through a per-instance vtable. The 8-byte shape matches a single fat-pointer (kind tag + target ptr) or a pair (key, value). Most likely a CURSOR / ITERATOR entry returned when walking D20540 containers - the __pow returning bool and __len returning size suggests this is a 'view' into a single container slot with its own metaclass dispatch.

subsystemUnification.entrypoint: FUN_00d085b0 (_onLoop.__index from the lge bootstrap attribution pass) -> FUN_00d1ce10 (class registration, takes class table + name + 'BaseClass' tag) -> FUN_00D20B00 (installs instance metatable)
subsystemUnification.instanceMutation: User script does `instance._tag = value` -> D20B00 __newindex (FUN_00d175b0) detects _tag branch, allocates 0x54 bytes (= D207A0 inner), routes through FUN_00d26b10/26ea0
subsystemUnification.memoryModel: Each instance has 3 pools (D208A0 wrappers) at struct offsets +0x60/+0x64/+0x68: save (persistent), temp (transient), sync (network-replicated). Pool exposes 15 bookkeeping fields read-only.
subsystemUnification.memberRecords: D207A0 represents one member descriptor. D20540 is a fixed-length container of these. D20670 is a tiny cursor that dispatches through whatever object it points to.

rttiPresence.note: Unlike the luacontrol userdata pass (LuaControl had Component::Lua::GameEngine::LuaControl RTTI), no template or caller in this cluster references RTTI_Type_Descriptor or dynamic_cast. The wrapped C++ types are non-polymorphic (or the dynamic_cast is hidden behind the FUN_00d272d0 / FUN_00d16cd0 helper layer). Type names assigned here are FUNCTIONAL (Engine/role-derived) rather than RTTI-confirmed - confidence is 'hypothesis-strong'.
